note: What a server sends to stop a unit where it stands. The header names the unit.

fields.name: x
fields.note: Where the unit stands, in world units; a client keeps this height rather than the ground's.

fields.name: z
fields.note: Where it stands, in world units.

revisions.note: It carries no sync id: a client always applies the position and facing, then stops the unit.

fields.name: x
fields.note: Where the unit stands, in world units; a client keeps this height rather than the ground's.

fields.name: z
fields.note: Where it stands, in world units.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The unit's movement count. A client drops the message where it is behind the last the unit took by less than 1073741824.

revisions.note: A client applies it only where its sync id is not older than the last the unit took, counting a wrap: this message, PathWithSpeed and Path share one count per unit, starting at -1.
